record.title: Evaluate source serial point compatibility
record.intent: Decide whether the observed control surface is usable or needs a bounded correction.
requirements: Compare candidate framing, transport result and operator screen witness. Do not equate a completed write or absent reply with command acceptance.
Classify UI command interpretation as supported, contradicted, or unresolved; RF qualification and persistence remain separate. Preserve the actual final point/output indication.
Identify the smallest useful continuation for source control or RF preparation, without blind protocol variation, automatic retry, calibration, firmware work or scope interaction.
acceptance: A scoped compatibility conclusion and next action follow the retained evidence.

review.rationale: Operator clarification establishes that the complete supplied leaflet is already held and describes onboard UI only. Withdraw the unsupported request for missing protocol pages. Existing documents do not establish USB-driven LCD refresh, so the negative screen observation does not independently classify command acceptance. The decision remains complete with an unresolved hardware result and a corrected continuation.

evidence.evaluation: docs/research/rf-source-point-decision.md now compares the complete leaflet, preserved HawkRAO and element14 reports, OLED manual and IC references. HawkRAO frame rules still match the transmitted bytes, but no mandatory LCD refresh or ACK is specified. element14 explicitly reports not determining USB control. Supplied snapshot SHA-256s remain 92474f2d2cca5e3da2fa8598fa132e825c1e6c2710564c6f7f354ced6c45a527 and e6eae7b3ecfc25a89db8bf0bfcb1465c829d3ce2698444a1fdb219aceb1cb3fd.
evidence.limitations: Original single-write, empty receive and unchanged-screen evidence is preserved. No additional device operation occurred. LCD refresh was an experimental assumption; command interpretation, actual RF and persistence remain unresolved. No assertion of board-specific remote-mode prerequisites or replacement protocol is justified.
evidence.continuation: No further documentation request to the operator. A discriminating RF-frequency observation after source/input qualification is the strongest current candidate: observe requested 100 MHz versus displayed 470 MHz before sending another command. Do not replace missing evidence with blind retries or unrelated OLED protocol.
